name: NVIDIA Corp
day_summary: NVDA slipped −1.6% to $218.66, drifting lower for a third session as the post-record cool-down continued and momentum names came off the boil. Shorts edged it; the slide from the $235 high was orderly but persistent.

decision.rationale: Trend still up but losing momentum from the record. HOLD core; let the pullback find a level before adding rather than chasing a stretched name lower.

positioning.notable_flow: Quiet, balanced flow; modest hedging as the stock eased off the highs.

what_traders_are_doing: Profit-taking after the record run; long-term holders sitting tight while fast money trims into the cool-down.

news.label: NVDA continues to ease from its May 14 record of $235.47 as momentum tech consolidates

outlook.short_term: Consolidating lower; support building in the $210–$218 zone.

bull_case: Orderly pullback from a record on no fundamental news.
AI order book and data-center growth underpin the trend.
bear_case: Momentum fading from the ATH; stretched valuation.
A break of $210 would accelerate the unwind.
